value.text: Two hand-started OMP seats survived isolated daemon/key restarts; the body arrived inline and spine recorded message.pushed to delivery.inbox-ack with no pointer.
The same target OMP used pij_send successfully after the per-boot key rotated.

Reconnect, cursor-map replay, async consumption ordering, poison retry, refusal fallback, notice, seat continuity, and exactly-once inbox acknowledgement are covered by the focused adapter suite and independently approved in review r3.
Key rotation retries with the reread key exactly once; two authentication refusals surface without looping.
RED-first witnesses were reproduced independently; final focused suite passed 43 tests, full suite passed 4632 tests, typecheck passed, and harness checks passed all eight sensors.
